artifact:
Feature: Doorstop Requirements - U01_2

  Scenario: Unique Identifiers for Linkable Text [REQ003]
    Given I have created a section of text
    When I link the section of text
    Then a unique and permanent identifier is assigned to the linked section
    And the identifier is retrievable

  Scenario Outline: Unique Identifiers - Multiple Sections [REQ003]
    Given I have created <count> sections of text
    When I link each section of text
    Then each section has a unique and permanent identifier
    Examples:
      | count |
      | 1     |
      | 5     |
      | 10    |

  Scenario: Formatting within Linkable Text [REQ004]
    Given I have created a section of text with formatting (bold, italic, underline)
    When I link the section of text
    Then the formatting is preserved in the linked section
    And the linked section displays the formatting correctly

  Scenario: Store External Requirements Asset - Valid File [REQ001]
    Given I have a valid requirements asset file (e.g., .docx, .pdf, .txt)
    When I attempt to store the asset in Doorstop
    Then the asset is stored successfully
    And I can retrieve the asset by its name

  Scenario: Store External Requirements Asset - Invalid File [REQ001]
    Given I have an invalid requirements asset file (e.g., unsupported format)
    When I attempt to store the asset in Doorstop
    Then an error message is displayed indicating the invalid file type
    And the asset is not stored

  Scenario: Import Content from Requirements Management Tool [REQ016]
    Given I have content in a supported requirements management tool (as specified)
    When I import the content into Doorstop
    Then the content is imported successfully
    And the imported content is displayed correctly in Doorstop

  Scenario: Export Content to Text Tool [REQ017]
    Given I have requirements content in Doorstop
    When I export the content to a text file
    Then the exported file is created successfully
    And the exported file contains the requirements content

  Scenario: Export Content to Document Tool [REQ017]
    Given I have requirements content in Doorstop
    When I export the content to a document file (e.g., .docx)
    Then the exported file is created successfully
    And the exported file contains the requirements content

  Scenario: View Requirements as a Document [REQ007]
    Given I have requirements content in Doorstop
    When I request to view the requirements as a document
    Then a document view of the requirements is displayed
    And the document view is readable and navigable

  Scenario Outline: View Document Items Interactively [REQ008]
    Given I have a document view of requirements
    When I interact with a document item (e.g., click on a section)
    Then the corresponding details of the item are displayed
    Examples:
      | Interaction | Expected Result |
      | Click Section | Section details displayed |
      | Hover Section | Section tooltip displayed |

  Scenario: Baseline Version of Requirements - Create Baseline [REQ009]
    Given I have a current version of requirements
    When I create a baseline of the current version
    Then a baseline is created successfully
    And the baseline is identifiable by a unique name/timestamp

  Scenario: Baseline Version of Requirements - View Baseline [REQ009]
    Given I have a created baseline of requirements
    When I request to view the baseline
    Then the baseline version of the requirements is displayed
    And the displayed version matches the baseline's timestamp
